name: List Inline Block (Layout Builder Blocks)
description: Lists inline blocks created through Layout Builder and where they are used, via UI and Drush.
project_description:
The List Inline Block modules provides the users to get the details of Inline Blocks (Custom Block created through Layout Builder) and the nodes where it is used through UI and Drush Commands.

 Features 
 This module helps the Site Builder and even Developer to determine where the inline blocks are used which would be helpful in maintaing and removing a Block type and other related activities.

 Post-Installation 
 The user can access the blocks from UI by navigating to /admin/structure/block/list-inline-block and using drush command "drush inline-block:list blockType ". In drush command, needs to provide the exact machine name of the block type used in Layout Builder pages.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module has dependency of core module Layout Builder and it's dependencies.
